channel.title: How to write something in a canon when no one else has heard it before?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "How to write something in a canon when no one else has heard it before?" - Something I was thinking about after I told a critter told me they weren't aware of the canon my idea would take place in.

item.title: Re: How to write something in a canon when no one else has heard it before?
item.content:encoded: You might also consider reaching out to the original authors of that canon, who might like to take a look at new work set in their world.

item.title: Re: How to write something in a canon when no one else has heard it before?
item.content:encoded: Honestly, just reach out to people on the butterfly squad roster, and check out our IRC Chats since more people may be interested in taking a peek.

item.title: How to write something in a canon when no one else has heard it before?
item.content:encoded:
I was seeking feedback as well as greenlight for a concept of a tale, and it takes place in the Apotheosis Canon during the 2018 Doomsday Challenge. I assumed a good chunk of members here in the wiki read or at least heard of this canon.

I PM'd a critter and they told me that they weren't familiar with the canon, nor are they interested in reading the canon to provide further critique. As well with other criticism they were able to provide. I told them that I understood and wished them a nice day.

Today I edited my concept around the criticisms I did got and went out seeking feedback again.

So how do I write for a canon that possibly no one else is aware of?
